description: This file defines API routes for managing events in an event planner application. It uses FastAPI to implement endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting events, with dependency injection for authentication and validation.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A generic pagination response model wrapping a list of items with pagination metadata.

classes.name: EventOut
classes.description: Schema representing an event for output purposes.

classes.name: EventCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new event.

classes.name: EventUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing event.

classes.name: CurrentUser
classes.description: Schema representing the authenticated user context.

methods.name: list_events( limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list events for the authenticated user.

methods.name: create_event(payload: EventCreate, current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new event.

methods.name: get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single event by ID.

methods.name: update_event( event_id: str, payload: EventUpdate, current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing event.

methods.name: delete_event(event_id: str, current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an event by ID.

ctags.name: get_event
ctags.signature: ( event_id: str = Path(..., description="ID of the event"), current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )

ctags.name: list_events
ctags.signature: ( limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )

ctags.name: update_event
ctags.signature: ( event_id: str, payload: EventUpdate, current_user: CurrentUser = Depends(verify_firebase_token), )
